mechanism_claims.claim_text: GG3 and related centrosymmetric peptides are supported by primary assays as membrane-active peptides that permeabilize bacterial model membranes and E. coli membranes.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GG3-centered mechanism with GG2/AA2/AA3 comparators where figures test multiple peptides

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Flow cytometry and electron microscopy support membrane integrity damage and morphology disruption in E. coli ATCC 25922 at 1 x MBC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GG2, GG3, AA2, AA3 and melittin-treated E. coli ATCC 25922 where shown

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GG3 is source-supported as binding DNA in vitro and in vivo, but the primary bactericidal interpretation remains bounded to membrane damage plus DNA-binding evidence rather than a quantified intracellular target hierarchy.
